$comment: Provenance + activation registry. Manual edits only; nothing reads this automatically. See registry/README.md.

skills.name: Vercel React Best Practices
skills.license: MIT (declared in SKILL.md frontmatter; upstream repo has no LICENSE file, so no license text is bundled)
skills.purpose: 70 prioritized React/Next.js performance rules (waterfalls, bundle size, rendering, server components).
skills.trigger: Writing, reviewing or refactoring React/Next.js code; data fetching, bundle or performance work.
skills.conflicts: No overlap with frontend-design (visual) or seo (page speed at HTML/CWV level). Rules target current Next.js; check against the Portfolio's Next 14.2.5 / React 18.3.1 before applying any rule that names a newer API.

skills.name: WCAG Audit Patterns
skills.purpose: WCAG 2.2 audit method: automated + manual testing, remediation patterns.
skills.trigger: Auditing a site for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, building accessible components.
dependencies: optional, only if the user runs them: @axe-core/cli, pa11y, lighthouse (shown as doc examples, never auto-run)
skills.conflicts: Complements the /audit command and ux-patterns (neither has a WCAG checklist). The upstream ui-design plugin has its own accessibility-compliance skill; that one is not imported.

skills.name: Vercel Composition Patterns
skills.license: MIT (SKILL.md frontmatter; no repo LICENSE file)
skills.purpose: React component composition (compound components, avoiding boolean-prop sprawl).
skills.conflicts: Narrow; held back to keep the first pass small.

skills.name: Web Interface Guidelines
skills.purpose: UI code review against Vercel's web interface guidelines.
dependencies: fetches its rules from raw.githubusercontent.com on every run
skills.conflicts: Not activated: it pulls instructions from a mutable remote URL at run time, so its behaviour is neither pinned nor reviewable. Vendor the fetched file at a pinned commit before activating.

skills.name: playwright-cli
skills.purpose: Drive a real browser from the shell (snapshot, click, screenshot, trace) for live verification.
skills.installType: reference (needs the @playwright/cli npm package, not installed)
skills.conflicts: Overlaps playwright-e2e only on the Playwright name: playwright-e2e is about writing test files, this is interactive browsing. Its frontmatter pre-approves Bash(playwright-cli:*) and Bash(npx playwright:*), which widens permissions, so activation needs an explicit decision and an installed CLI.

skills.name: Insecure Defaults
skills.purpose: Finds fail-open defaults and hardcoded secrets.
skills.installType: reference (plugin layout; tests/ and workflows/ dropped on import because they hold runnable scripts)
skills.conflicts: Share-alike licence: activating or adapting it makes the derived text CC-BY-SA, which needs a decision before it spreads to junctioned repos.

skills.name: Sharp Edges
skills.purpose: Reviews API and config designs for footguns. Read-only tools.
skills.conflicts: Same licence note as insecure-defaults. Aimed at crypto/API ergonomics, little use for static sites.

skills.name: wshobson ui-design plugin (9 skills)
skills.purpose: Design-system, interaction, responsive and visual-foundation skills.
skills.conflicts: responsive-design duplicates responsive-craft; visual-design-foundations and interaction-design overlap frontend-design and ux-patterns. Mine for ideas, do not activate.

rejected.reason: 58 MB bundle with install.sh/install.ps1, hooks/, .mcp.json and many tool-config dirs; it installs itself and registers hooks. Pick single skills by hand if needed. Several ECC skills already appear in the user-level skill list, so they are not Vault's to add.
Supabase and Postgres only; no connected repo uses Supabase. Ships .mcp.json.

frontend-design already exists locally and webapp-testing overlaps playwright-e2e. No repo-level licence (terms are per skill, some proprietary). Many document skills are already available as anthropic-skills:* in the user setup.
130 MB collection of Copilot-flavoured agents, instructions and hooks. Browse upstream for ideas; nothing imported.
